title: Reaction Picker
content: Build reaction picker component. Quick reactions: row of common emojis (❤️ 😂 😮 😢 😡 👍). Expanded picker: full emoji keyboard on expand. Animation: emoji pops/scales on hover and select. Display: reactions shown below content with counts. Remove: tap own reaction to remove. Tooltip: shows who reacted.

variants.simple: Create emoji reaction picker for posts and messages.
variants.detailed: Build reaction picker component. Quick reactions: row of common emojis (❤️ 😂 😮 😢 😡 👍). Expanded picker: full emoji keyboard on expand. Animation: emoji pops/scales on hover and select. Display: reactions shown below content with counts. Remove: tap own reaction to remove. Tooltip: shows who reacted.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive emoji reaction picker for posts and messages. Quick reaction bar: appears on hover/long-press near content. Layout: bg-white rounded-full shadow-lg px-2 py-1.5 flex gap-1. Common reactions: 6 default emojis (❤️ 😂 😮 😢 😡 👍), customizable per platform. Each emoji: w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center text-xl cursor-pointer. Hover effect: transform scale-150 transition-transform with slight Y offset (pop up). Select animation: brief scale-125 pulse then reaction applied. Expand trigger: + button or long-press any emoji opens full picker. Full emoji picker: larger popover/modal, emoji grid organized by category (Smileys, Gestures, Animals, Food, etc.), category tabs, recent/frequently used section at top, search emoji input, skin tone selector for applicable emoji. Reaction display (below content): flex flex-wrap gap-1. Each unique reaction: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-sm flex items-center gap-1, emoji + count, bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200, own reaction highlighted (bg-blue-100 border border-blue-300). Tooltip on hover: shows who reacted ("Sarah, John, and 5 others"). Click reaction: if same as yours removes your reaction, if different switches to that, if from others adds yours. Reaction detail modal: clicking reaction count opens modal showing all users who used each reaction, tabs per emoji, user rows with Follow action. Animation: reactions animate when added (float up + fade out effect), count increments with brief highlight. Reaction limit: max reactions per content (e.g., 1 per user per item). Super reactions: premium/animated reactions for subscribers. Custom reactions: if platform supports, add custom emoji/stickers as reactions. Real-time: reactions update live via WebSocket. Notifications: notify content author of reactions (grouped). Message reactions: inline display next to message bubble, different positioning. Remove reaction: tap your own reaction to remove. Accessibility: picker navigable by keyboard, reaction type and count announced, button clearly labeled.
